title: Which Steve Carell Character Are You, Deep Down?
dek: From cringe-comedy softie to Oscar-nominated menace, one of these eight guys is basically your personality on screen — take the quiz to find out which.

quiz.intro: Answer honestly — there's no boss move, no lamp, and no wrestling mat wrong answer here.

questions.question: You accidentally say something wildly inappropriate in a meeting. What happens next?

answers.text: I double down, make it worse, then somehow turn it into a bonding moment
I quietly implode and start listing every worst-case scenario in my head
I just... didn't notice anything was wrong. Moving on.
I get so flustered I start yelling about something completely unrelated

questions.question: Unexpected fame or attention lands on you overnight. Your instinct?

answers.text: I retreat further into my own head and assume it'll be taken away soon
I treat it like just another day, then quietly go back to my routine
I get distracted by something shiny in the room within ten seconds
I panic, then secretly love it more than I'll admit

questions.question: Be honest — how do you handle a crush you're not supposed to have?

answers.text: I get nervous, overthink every detail, and somehow still charm my way through
I blurt out something like 'I love you, do you love me back?' with zero filter
I act tough about it until one small moment cracks me wide open
I try to control every part of it because feelings are terrifying

questions.question: Your family reunion is a certified disaster. How do you cope?

answers.text: I say something completely off-topic and confuse the whole table
I pretend I don't need anyone, then get oddly protective of the little ones
I isolate myself and let my resentment simmer under a calm surface
I make everything a friendly wager, obviously

questions.question: Someone challenges you to prove yourself. What's your move?

answers.text: I act like I don't care about approval, but I secretly crave it
I train obsessively and get unsettlingly intense about winning
I turn it into a full media circus because deep down I need people watching
I try to avoid conflict, then accidentally make it worse trying to smooth things over

questions.question: What's your love-life instinct, deep down?

answers.text: I struggle to be vulnerable and it comes out as control instead
I flirt like it's a competitive sport, because to me, it kind of is
I fall for exactly the person I'm not supposed to, at the worst possible time
I fall hard and fast and tell everyone about it immediately

questions.question: Your boss/mentor figure lets you down. How do you react?

answers.text: I turn it into a public grudge match
I overcorrect and become way too controlling with the people I DO have power over
I take it way too personally and need everyone to reassure me I'm still liked
I spiral, but I keep it to myself so I don't burden anyone else

questions.question: A young kid needs comfort or guidance. What do you do?

answers.text: I get overprotective to the point of controlling their whole life
I awkwardly try to be their best friend instead of an authority figure
I let them comfort ME, honestly, and I'm grateful for it
I get nervous but try to be honest with them, even when it's clumsy

questions.question: How do you handle being underestimated by everyone around you?

answers.text: I get louder and more determined to prove I deserve the spotlight
I've stopped fighting it — I assume they might be right
I don't mind much, honestly. I'm comfortable being underestimated.
I genuinely don't notice I'm being underestimated at all

questions.question: Last one — what's your idea of a perfect win?

answers.text: Just... surviving the week without another crisis, honestly
Getting to keep my quiet, orderly little life exactly the way I like it
Whatever random thing made me happy in the moment — a lamp, a compliment, doesn't matter
Realizing the family I built matters more than the reputation I was chasing

results.name: Michael Scott
results.subtitle: The Office (2005-2013)
results.description: You need to be loved more than you need to be right, and you'll absolutely humiliate yourself trying to make that happen. Underneath the cringe, though, is a genuinely huge heart that shows up when it matters most.

results.name: Frank Ginsberg
results.subtitle: Little Miss Sunshine (2006)
results.description: You're sharp, sarcastic, and privately carrying more heartbreak than you let on. You've hit real lows, but somewhere on the road trip of life you find your way back to caring again.

results.name: Andy Stitzer
results.subtitle: The 40-Year-Old Virgin (2005)
results.description: You're organized, a little insular, and completely fine doing things at your own pace no matter what anyone else thinks. You don't need to rush — when the right thing finally clicks, you're all in.

results.name: Brick Tamland
results.subtitle: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004)
results.description: You say the wrong thing at the wrong time constantly, and somehow it's always endearing instead of embarrassing. Pure chaos, zero malice, all heart.

results.name: Gru
results.subtitle: Despicable Me (2010)
results.description: You act tough and standoffish, but it's a total front — one small vulnerable moment and you're completely rearranged as a person. You'll deny it, but you're a softie who ended up loving the family you never planned on.

results.name: John du Pont
results.subtitle: Foxcatcher (2014)
results.description: You're controlled, unsettling, and desperate to be valued in ways you can't quite express in healthy terms. This is Carell's Oscar-nominated dramatic turn, and if this is your result, you contain more darkness than anyone around you realizes.

results.name: Bobby Riggs
results.subtitle: Battle of the Sexes (2017)
results.description: You turn everything into a show, thrive on attention, and gamble your reputation for one more shot at relevance. Underneath the hustler act, though, is someone just desperate to be liked.

results.name: Dan Burns
results.subtitle: Dan in Real Life (2007)
results.description: You give great advice to literally everyone except yourself, and your instinct to protect the people you love tips over into controlling more often than you'd like. Once you loosen your grip a little, you're capable of real, unexpected romance.
